meta.name: Persona 5 menu and battle UI (reference only)
meta.description: Design DNA extracted from four Persona 5 screenshots supplied by the user on 2026-11-17. Used as a craft bar for EMO RUSH, not as a look to copy. See persona5-transfer.md for what carries over.
source_references: pause menu (Items/Equip/Persona/Stats/Bond/Request/System) over red-and-black character art
battle command wheel with 1 MORE interrupt and party HP/SP HUD
negotiation dialogue with angled response options

color.palette_type: monochromatic red with black and white; a spectral glitch band appears only behind the selected item

primary.role: signal red: menu fields, selection shapes, radiating bursts

secondary.role: deep red: tinted full-screen backgrounds behind menus

accent.role: measured accent; same red that drives selection

neutral.usage: #FAFAFA is the foreground for all type on black and red; #040303 is the dominant ground and the outline ink around white letters; mid greys only in tinted 3D scenery

color.contrast_strategy: maximum: pure black, pure white and one saturated red; no mid-tone UI surfaces

font_families.heading: custom cut-out lettering: every glyph from a different face, size and baseline, white letters with heavy black keylines
font_families.body: plain bold grotesque, upright, set inside angled boxes

typography.font_style_notes: Headlines mix uppercase and lowercase glyphs of different families in one word; scale jumps are huge (display is about 10x body); numerals are condensed italic with a dark outline

spacing.base_unit: none fixed; items overlap by 10-30% of their height
spacing.section_rhythm: no sections; one screen is one composition with one focal word

layout.columns: 1 menu column stepped on a 15-25 degree diagonal, character art owning the opposite third

shape.border_usage: bold borders: 6-10px black keylines around white letters, white keylines around black panels

elevation.shadow_style: hard drop: a duplicated slab offset behind the element in red or black, zero blur

levels.high: two stacked offset slabs plus a radiating burst

iconography.style: flat white glyphs with black outline; stars and controller-button keys

motion.easing: fast ease-out with overshoot; hard cuts between screens
motion.entrance_pattern: items slam in along their diagonal with a small rotation and settle with overshoot
motion.exit_pattern: hard cut or a full-screen wipe in the accent color
motion.philosophy: cinematic-snappy: every confirmation is a beat

components.button_style: text-only items; the selected one grows, flips to inverted colors and gets a jagged red or spectral shape behind it
components.card_style: angled black slabs with white keyline
components.navigation_pattern: vertical list stepped on a diagonal; battle uses a radial fan around the character
components.modal_style: jagged speech-bubble polygons and angled banners
components.list_style: staggered, each line offset and rotated a few degrees differently
components.component_notes: Character portrait always paired with dialogue; counters (money, HP/SP) are set as large italic numerals in the corners

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: ransom note and calling card cut from magazines
aesthetic.era_influence: punk zine collage and 1960s jazz record sleeves, rendered with modern anime art

visual_language.ornamentation: decorative, but every ornament carries a selection or state
visual_language.whitespace_usage: black space as tension, never empty
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: menu heavy on one side, character art heavy on the other, diagonal between them
visual_language.focal_strategy: single hero element per screen (the selected item or the interrupt word)
visual_language.texture_usage: halftone dots, radiating star bursts, tinted posterized 3D scenery

composition.flow_direction: diagonal, top-left to bottom-right or radial from the character
composition.negative_space_role: black field that makes white and red shout

imagery.photo_treatment: background 3D scene tinted to a single red or posterized to black and white
imagery.illustration_style: anime character art in black, white and red only
imagery.pattern_usage: halftone and radial bursts behind selections

interaction_feel.feedback_style: every input answers with a slam, sound and color flip
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: selected item jumps in scale and inverts
interaction_feel.loading_style: animated character silhouette running across the screen

overview.primary_technology: game engine 2D layers; reproducible as layered 2D drawing

background_effects.description: The 3D world behind menus is tinted to one red or posterized; radiating red spikes burst behind the active command wheel

3d_elements.description: 3D characters and environments sit behind a flat 2D UI layer

shader_effects.description: Full-screen tint and posterize when menus open

scroll_morphing.description: Not applicable to a TV game UI

text_effects.description: Each letter is its own cut-out with its own face and angle; words slam in as one unit with overshoot

params.split_strategy: by-char for styling, by-word for motion

cursor_effects.description: Controller UI; the selection shape is the cursor

image_effects.description: Character art and panels enter through angled clip shapes

svg_animations.description: Jagged selection slabs and bursts redraw instantly as the selection moves

visual_effects.composite_notes: Extracted from stills only, so motion values are estimates. The signature elements (red-black-white palette, ransom-note lettering, star and skull motifs, calling-card graphics, character art) belong to Persona 5 and are not to be reused; persona5-transfer.md lists what EMO RUSH takes instead.
